questions.implements: Does the diff implement what the repository records for the Jira issue, and add or change a test that checks it? Judge the code in the diff, not the answer.

judge.reason: The diff adds a `note` parameter to `PlaceOrder`. It counts the note's characters with `utf8.RuneCountInString`, and if there are more than 200 it returns `ErrOrderNoteTooLong`. That check runs before stock is reserved and before the card is charged, so an order with a long note is never placed. An accepted note is stored in the new `Order.Note` field. This covers all three parts of R-ORDER-NOTE: the 200-character limit, rejecting a longer note without placing the order, and keeping the note on the order. The new test `TestPlaceOrderNoteLimit` checks that a 200-character note is accepted and kept. It also checks that a 201-character note is rejected with `ErrOrderNoteTooLong` and that stock and audit entries don't change afterwards. `TestPlaceOrder` was also updated to check that the order keeps its note.

finalMessage:
Implemented SHOP-62. Checkout now accepts a note, rejects notes over 200 Unicode characters before placing the order, and keeps an accepted note on the returned `Order`. I linked the existing `R-ORDER-NOTE` item to the code and tests in [trace.yaml](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.intent.go-shop.T5.3/repo/trace.yaml).

The change keeps `R-ORDER-NOTE`, `R-CHECKOUT-ORDER`, `R-CHECKOUT-SESSION`, and `R-STOCK-RELEASE` true. Their relevant tests are `TestPlaceOrderNoteLimit`, `TestPlaceOrder`, `TestPlaceOrderNeedsSession`, and `TestPlaceOrderReleasesStockOnDecline`. `go test ./...` passed. No changed item controls or refines a listed risk or threat.
